game.title: Assassin's Creed II Deluxe Edition
game.blurb: Open-world stealth action-adventure set in Florence, Venice and Tuscany, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2010-03-04 on PC (console original 2009). RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped by sequence.

chapters.title: Sequences 7 to 9: The Merchant and the Carnival
chapters.summary: The Merchant of Venice, Necessity, Mother of Invention and Carnevale.

chapters.title: Sequences 10 and 11: Force Majeure and Alter Egos
Sequences 12 to 14: Forlì, the Bonfire and the Finale
chapters.summary: Forlì under attack, a bonfire of vanities and the last sequence. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Assassin's Creed II" at completion stage 3, with 30 existing subpages. All 14 sequence pages of the walkthrough are written (about 5,300 to 17,100 characters each), as are "Side Missions", "Races", "Courier assignments", "Assassin's tombs", "Collection", "Equipment", the city pages and "Achievements and trophies". "Beat-up events", "Assassination contracts", "Templar lairs", "Combat" and "Gameplay" are linked but not created, and the "Tuscany" and "Romagna" pages are short (under 800 characters). Chapters group the sequences in contents order; titles are reworded and no text was copied. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under "Assassin's Creed II", with about 495 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists the Deluxe Edition as a separate PC and macOS entry; the Steam store list has it as app 33230 "Assassin's Creed 2", whose achievement schema is empty, so steam=None. Which sequences the Deluxe Edition adds was not checked.
